questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All Shirts are Cottons.

Some Shirts are Nets.

**Conclusions:**

I. All Nets are Shirts.

II. Some Nets are Cottons.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
Statements:

All Shirts are Cottons.

Some Shirts are Nets.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4766a86c45a8689ec29fd0b79bb9f8a053ad1ee7b053c5b9bbe485518f4429db.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All Nets are Shirts. - **False **(because Some Shirts are Nets. So, All nets are shirts it is not definite)

II. Some Nets are Cottons. - **True** (because All Shirts are Cottons and Some Shirts are Nets. So, Some Nets are Cottons it is definite) 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows."**

questions.question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite to the face showing ‘3’. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b652ada82f62476fae99c1dea15647c72e68dfa9ba0e4c469402653c3b68d22a.png]
questions.solution:
For find the opposite surface of '3', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8c7952c8fec9d83e9fe9418f7d98562a0ae2cc6e2b41be12ca396f3343d01da.png] 

From both dices, 4 is common and on the same surface. So, all remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

2 is opposite to 5.

4 is opposite to 1.

So, **3 is opposite to 6.**

Hence, the correct answer is "6".

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(4, 42, 5),(3, 45, 7)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: 

Logic: (1st number + 2) × (3rd number + 2) = 2nd number.

Now,

For (4, 42, 5):

⇒ (4 + 2) × (5 + 2)

= 6 × 7 = 42.

For (3, 45, 7)

⇒ (3 + 2) × (7 + 2)

= 5 × 9 = 45.

Similarly, for **Option 2: (6, 32, 2)**

**⇒ (6 + 2) × (2 + 2) **

**= 8 × 4 = 32. **

Hence, the correct answer is Option 2.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the sixth term is related to the fifth term.

400 : 200 :: 248 : ? :: 256 : 128
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (2nd number × 2) = 1st number.

Now,

For, 400 : 200

⇒ 200 × 2 = 400.

For, 256 : 128

⇒ 128 × 2 = 256.

Similarly, for 248 ∶ ?

**⇒ 248 / 2 = 124.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
